Full-depth wave: one scene per inventoried record, whole-first opening references the wave-1 S3 whole without duplicating it. Presented under the family-factory tint pair per s-products-corpus-base.

Moves: the module's own Part order carries the arc — ownership and constitution hold (guard: the boundary and the four layers are the module's law), the MEF manifold and Becoming turn (vortex: the manifold is where forms re-form), Objective internality emerges as application, client integration and the wayfinder maps gather (intake), determinism holds, the development programme walks, acceptance settles. Becoming walks its own square (04-MEF-BECOMING's Part VI §33 'Square C — Becoming') via its title segments.

3D: the whole scene carries the member's depth — z is the Factory's own transformation depth: intention and commission nearest, the re-formed result deepest (laminated; depthPerspective on). Pointers follow the arc's meaning (guard=canon holds its edges, gather=material intake, vortex=the run turns, rupture=gate refusal/cutover, settle=acceptance quiet). Automation: a dispersion LFO on one scene per member — the run breathes. Durations/transitions step 10–16s / 1.2–2.2 with the arc.

Sequences are the Factory's native grammar: the title formation walks its own heading segments and re-forms at its address stamp.
